description: Defines the payload for the issue type screen schemes. See https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-issue-type-screen-schemes/\#api-rest-api-3-issuetypescreenscheme-post

description.description: The description of the issue type screen scheme
description.example: This is an issue type screen scheme

explicitMappings.description: The IDs of the screen schemes for the issue type IDs and default. A default entry is required to create an issue type screen scheme, it defines the mapping for all issue types without a screen scheme.

name.description: The name of the issue type screen scheme
